anomalies.observed: The netlist includes all six 0 Ω jumpers, with no DNP or other population qualification. With them fitted, R9/R10 tie both PWM1 bus-pin alternatives together, R11/R12 tie both PWM2 alternatives together, and R13/R14 merge the servo signal pins with /TTL. The 1 kΩ paths through R3/R4 then connect both PWM outputs to that shared serial bus.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, assembly should select only one PWM bus-pin mapping for the applicable Core variant, and should select either PWM mode or serial mode: R13/R14 should be open in PWM mode, while the PWM GPIO paths should not be connected to the shared serial bus in serial mode.
